title: Esrbespoke accordion
description: A hairline across the full width, a tiny capital label at the left and, from column 7, a stack of 20px rows each closed by a hairline with a small caret at the right. Pressing a row slides its answer open (height eases open, the caret flips).
notes: needs JavaScript to open rows (hydrate: visible)
the open animation is off under reduced motion
